f_air_conditioner.name: cooling unit
f_air_conditioner.description: A big, blocky metal device for refrigerating large areas, now just a source of parts to salvage and repurpose.

f_nanofab_portable.name: portable nanofabricator unit
f_nanofab_portable.description: An ugly amalgamation, grafted together from a nanofabricator body, its control panel, and a huge plutonium fuel cell to power it.  Needless to say, it's significantly more fragile, but more compact and portable.  Somewhat.

f_air_filter.name: central air filter
f_air_filter.description: Cleans out dust mites, smoke particles, and more!

f_dishwasher.name: dishwasher
f_dishwasher.description: This metal box used to spray hot water and soap at dirty dishes to make them clean and to save people an unpleasant chore.  Now, with the power gone and it sitting for a while, it's starting to smell a bit off.

f_dryer.name: dryer
f_dryer.description: 'Dry your clothes!' would be what you'd do if electricity was running.

f_floor_lamp_off.name: floor lamp (off)
f_floor_lamp_off.description: A tall standing lamp, meant to plug into a wall and light up a room.
f_floor_lamp_off.message: You switch on the floor lamp.

f_floor_lamp.name: floor lamp (no power)
f_floor_lamp.description: A tall standing lamp, plugged into a wall.  This one has no power.
f_floor_lamp.message: You switch off the floor lamp.

f_floor_lamp_on.name: floor lamp (on)
f_floor_lamp_on.description: A tall standing lamp, plugged into a wall.
f_floor_lamp_on.message: You switch off the floor lamp.

f_grid_floodlight_off.name: grid floodlight (off)
f_grid_floodlight_off.description: An industrial flood light, hooked up to draw from a local grid.  Flicking it on will output a nice, bright source of light.

f_grid_floodlight.name: grid floodlight (no power)
f_grid_floodlight.description: An industrial flood light, hooked up to draw from a local grid.  It's currently out of power.

f_grid_floodlight_on.name: grid floodlight (on)
f_grid_floodlight_on.description: An industrial flood light, hooked up to draw from a local grid.  It's currently providing plenty of light.

transform.msg: The utility light flickers and dies.

f_street_light_rewired_off.name: rewired street light (off)
f_street_light_rewired_off.description: A source of light used to illuminate streets and the surrounding area.  It's been rewired to draw power from a local grid, but is currently switched off.
f_street_light_rewired_off.message: You switch on the street light.

f_street_light_rewired.name: rewired street light (no power)
f_street_light_rewired.description: A source of light used to illuminate streets and the surrounding area.  It's been rewired to draw power from a local grid, but lacks power at the moment.
f_street_light_rewired.message: You switch off the street light.

f_street_light_rewired_on.name: rewired street light (on)
f_street_light_rewired_on.description: A source of light used to illuminate streets and the surrounding area.  It's been rewired to draw power from a local grid, brightening up the night once again.
f_street_light_rewired_on.message: You switch off the street light.

transform.msg: The street light flickers and dies.

f_glass_fridge_off.name: glass door fridge (off)
f_glass_fridge_off.description: There's something tantalizing about seeing the contents of a glass fridge on display.  It is switched off.
f_glass_fridge_off.message: You switch on the glass fridge.

f_glass_fridge.name: glass door fridge
f_glass_fridge.description: There's something tantalizing about seeing the contents of a glass fridge on display.  It has no power.
f_glass_fridge.message: You switch off the glass fridge.

f_glass_fridge_on.name: glass door fridge (on)
f_glass_fridge_on.description: There's something tantalizing about seeing the contents of a glass fridge on display.  It is switched on.
f_glass_fridge_on.message: You switch off the glass fridge.

f_glass_freezer_off.name: glass door freezer (off)
f_glass_freezer_off.description: A glass door freezer!  Maybe there's some ice cream inside.  It is switched off.
f_glass_freezer_off.message: You switch on the glass freezer.

f_glass_freezer.name: glass door freezer
f_glass_freezer.description: A glass door freezer!  Maybe there's some ice cream inside.  It has no power.
f_glass_freezer.message: You switch off the glass freezer.

f_glass_freezer_on.name: glass freezer (on)
f_glass_freezer_on.description: A glass door freezer!  Maybe there's some ice cream inside.  It is switched on.
f_glass_freezer_on.message: You switch off the glass freezer.

f_home_furnace.name: furnace
f_home_furnace.description: A gas-powered forced-air central heating unit, with an internal fan to push the air through a building's air ducts and keep it warm.

f_washer.name: washing machine
f_washer.description: You could wash your dirty clothes if electricity was running.

f_oven.name: oven
f_oven.description: Used for heating and cooking food with electricity.  Might still work, if you manage to power it.  It's safe to light a fire inside of it.

f_multicooker.name: multi cooker
f_multicooker.description: Used for automatic cooking food with electricity.

f_multicooker_improved.name: improved multi cooker
f_multicooker_improved.description: Used for automatic cooking food with electricity.

f_rvoven.name: RV kitchen unit
f_rvoven.description: Used for heating and cooking food with electricity.  Ripped from an RV.  It's safe to light a fire inside of it.

f_bellows.name: blacksmith bellows
f_bellows.description: Used for delivering air to increase the combustion and heat output of a forge.  Doesn't look like it's working, although it still has parts.

f_drophammer.name: blacksmith drop hammer
f_drophammer.description: Used for fast production of metal items.  Doesn't look like it's working, although it still has parts.

f_shredder.name: document shredder
f_shredder.description: It's not all about hiding government secrets, sometimes you just want to stop identity theft.

f_server.name: server stack
f_server.description: This is a big pile of computers.  They're all turned off, but if you can get power going it might be useful for training your Computers skill.

f_satellite.name: large satellite dish
f_satellite.description: Somewhere up there, there are still satellites, orbiting and doing their thing, sending signals down to an Earth that is no longer listening.

f_turbine_unit.name: mounted wind turbine
f_turbine_unit.description: A mounted wind turbine connected to building's electric grid.

f_xl_turbine_unit.name: mounted wind turbine
f_xl_turbine_unit.description: A large mounted wind turbine connected to building's electric grid.

f_water_wheel_unit.name: mounted water wheel
f_water_wheel_unit.description: A mounted water wheel connected to building's electric grid.

f_xl_water_wheel_unit.name: mounted large water wheel
f_xl_water_wheel_unit.description: A large mounted water wheel connected to building's electric grid.

f_solar_unit.name: mounted solar panel
f_solar_unit.description: A mounted solar panel connected to building's electric grid.

f_solar_unit_v2.name: mounted upgraded solar panel
f_solar_unit_v2.description: A mounted upgraded solar panel connected to building's electric grid.

f_foldable_solar_unit.name: mounted foldable solar panel
f_foldable_solar_unit.description: A mounted foldable solar panel connected to building's electric grid.

f_battery.name: mounted medium storage battery
f_battery.description: A storage battery mount salvaged from a vehicle, and connected to building's electric grid.

f_battery_large.name: mounted large storage battery
f_battery_large.description: A large storage battery mount salvaged from a vehicle, and connected to building's electric grid.

f_battery_huge.name: mounted very large storage battery
f_battery_huge.description: A huge storage battery mount salvaged from a vehicle, and connected to building's electric grid.

f_battery_small.name: mounted small storage battery
f_battery_small.description: A small storage battery, connected to building's electric grid.

f_battery_car.name: mounted car battery
f_battery_car.description: A lead-acid battery salvaged from a vehicle and connected to building's electric grid.

f_battery_motorbike.name: mounted motorbike battery
f_battery_motorbike.description: A small lead-acid battery salvaged from a vehicle and connected to building's electric grid.

f_battery_motorbike_small.name: mounted small motorbike battery
f_battery_motorbike_small.description: A tiny lead-acid battery salvaged from a vehicle and connected to building's electric grid.  Better than nothing if you're desperate to turn the lights back on.

f_charger.name: battery charger
f_charger.description: A battery charger connected to building's electric grid.

f_recharge_station.name: grid recharging station
f_recharge_station.description: A vehicle recharging station connected to building's electric grid, providing higher output than consumer battery chargers.

f_cable_connector.name: jumper cable connector
f_cable_connector.description: Power outlet connecting a building's electrical grid to a vehicle.  To use, attach a jumper cable to a vehicle and then to the connector.

f_gridwelder.name: grid welder
f_gridwelder.description: A portable welder connected to a electrical grid.

f_gridsmallgunkit.name: grid firearm repair kit
f_gridsmallgunkit.description: A firearm repair kit connected to an electrical grid.

f_gridgunkit.name: grid gunsmith repair kit
f_gridgunkit.description: A gunsmith kit connected to an electrical grid.

f_gridcon_mix.name: grid concrete mixer
f_gridcon_mix.description: A portable concrete mixer bolted down and wired into a building's electrical grid.  Has a built-in heater for cold-weather use.

f_welderrig.name: grid welding rig
f_welderrig.description: A vehicle welding rig connected to a electrical grid.  Has a soldering iron attached.

f_gridforge.name: grid forge
f_gridforge.description: A portable electric forge connected to a electrical grid.

f_forgerig.name: grid forge rig
f_forgerig.description: A vehicle forge rig connected to a electrical grid.

f_gridkiln.name: grid kiln
f_gridkiln.description: A portable electric kiln connected to a electrical grid.

f_griddehydrator.name: grid food dehydrator
f_griddehydrator.description: A portable food dehydrator connected to a electrical grid, that could be useful for preserving food.

f_gridfood_processor.name: grid food processor
f_gridfood_processor.description: A food processor connected to a electrical grid.  Capable of slicing, chopping, shredding, grinding, pureeing and mixing.

f_gridcoffeemaker.name: grid coffeemaker
f_gridcoffeemaker.description: A coffeemaker connected to an electrical grid, providing hot water for coffee and other drinks.

f_gridsoda_machine.name: soda machine
f_gridsoda_machine.description: A soda machine connected to a electrical grid.  Capable of creating carbonated drinks.

f_gridvac_sealer.name: grid vacuum sealer
f_gridvac_sealer.description: A portable heat sealer unit, connected to a electrical grid.  It could be used for vacuum-packing food to preserve it.

f_gridmakeshift_sealer.name: grid makeshift vacuum sealer
f_gridmakeshift_sealer.description: A portable homemade heat sealer unit, connected to a electrical grid.  It could be used for vacuum-packing food to preserve it.

f_craftrig.name: grid FOODCO kitchen buddy
f_craftrig.description: A multi-function crafting station, with a water purifier, food processor, food dehydrator, vacuum sealer, and hand press for making ammo.  Draws power from the electrical grid.  If you attempt to craft an item that needs one of the kitchen buddy's functions, it will automatically be selected as a tool.

f_gridelectrolysis_kit.name: grid electrolysis kit
f_gridelectrolysis_kit.description: A electrolysis kit connected to a electrical grid.

f_chemistry_set.name: grid chemistry set
f_chemistry_set.description: A chemistry set connected to a electrical grid, providing the functions of a hotplate and chemistry tools.

f_chemlab.name: grid chemistry lab
f_chemlab.description: A vehicle chemistry lab connected to a electrical grid, combining the functions of a hotplate, electrolysis kit, and chemistry tools.

f_gridhotplate.name: grid hotplate
f_gridhotplate.description: A small heating element on a stand, plugged into the electrical grid.

f_gridsolderingiron.name: grid soldering iron
f_gridsolderingiron.description: A soldering iron connected to a electrical grid.

f_fridge_off.name: refrigerator (off)
f_fridge_off.description: Refrigerate your food with the amazing science of electricity!  It is switched off.

f_fridge.name: refrigerator
f_fridge.description: Refrigerate your food with the amazing science of electricity!  It has no power.

f_fridge_on.name: refrigerator (on)
f_fridge_on.description: Refrigerate your food with the amazing science of electricity!  It is switched on.

f_freezer_off.name: freezer (off)
f_freezer_off.description: Freeze your food with the amazing science of electricity!  It is switched off.

f_freezer.name: freezer
f_freezer.description: Freeze your food with the amazing science of electricity!  It has no power.

f_freezer_on.name: freezer (on)
f_freezer_on.description: Freeze your food with the amazing science of electricity!  It is switched on.

f_freezer_industrial.name: industrial freezer
f_freezer_industrial.description: An industrial grade freezer, capable of preserving huge amounts of food, as long as it's powered.  It has no power.

f_freezer_industrial_off.name: industrial freezer (off)
f_freezer_industrial_off.description: An industrial grade freezer, capable preserving huge amounts of food, as long as it's powered.  It is switched off.

f_freezer_industrial_on.name: industrial freezer (on)
f_freezer_industrial_on.description: An industrial grade freezer, capable preserving huge amounts of food, as long as it's powered.  It is switched on.

f_minifridge_off.name: grid minifridge (off)
f_minifridge_off.description: Refrigerate your food with the amazing science of electricity!  It is switched off.

f_minifridge.name: grid minifridge
f_minifridge.description: Refrigerate your food with the amazing science of electricity!  It has no power.

f_minifridge_on.name: grid minifridge (on)
