f_minifreezer.name: minifreezer
f_minifreezer.description: Freeze your food with the amazing science of electricity!  It has no power.

f_minifreezer_on.name: minifreezer (on)
f_minifreezer_on.description: Freeze your food with the amazing science of electricity!  It is switched on.

f_gridautoclave.name: grid autoclave
f_gridautoclave.description: This thing is basically an extremely high tech laundry machine or dishwasher.  It steams things at temperatures that will kill almost anything.  It could be used to mend faulty bionics that need sterilization.

f_grid_air_conditioner.name: air conditioner (no power)
f_grid_air_conditioner.description: A window-mounted air conditioner, plugged into the wall.  This one has no power.

f_grid_air_conditioner_off.name: air conditioner (off)
f_grid_air_conditioner_off.description: A window-mounted air conditioner, plugged into the wall.  This one is currently turned off.

f_grid_air_conditioner_on.name: air conditioner (on)
f_grid_air_conditioner_on.description: A window-mounted air conditioner, plugged into the wall.  This one is running and providing cool air.

transform.msg: The AC runs out of power and cools off.

f_space_heater.name: space heater (no power)
f_space_heater.description: A small portable electric heater, plugged into a wall.  This one has no power.

f_space_heater_off.name: space heater (off)
f_space_heater_off.description: A small portable electric heater, plugged into a wall.  This one is currently turned off.

f_space_heater_on.name: space heater (on)
f_space_heater_on.description: A small portable electric heater, plugged into a wall.  This one is running and providing warmth.

transform.msg: The heater runs out of power and cools off.

f_space_heater_large.name: large space heater (no power)
f_space_heater_large.description: A large portable electric heater, plugged into a wall.  This one has no power.

f_space_heater_large_off.name: large space heater (off)
f_space_heater_large_off.description: A large portable electric heater, plugged into a wall.  This one is currently turned off.

f_space_heater_large_on.name: large space heater (on)
f_space_heater_large_on.description: A large portable electric heater, plugged into a wall.  This one is running and providing warmth.

transform.msg: The heater runs out of power and cools off.

f_grid_plut_generator.name: grid plutonium generator
f_grid_plut_generator.description: This imposing apparatus harnesses the power of the atom.  A compact nuclear reactor, sealed and configured to provide nearly limitless electrical power from refined nuclear fuel.  Now installed and connected, it will generate a small but constant source of electricity.

f_3d_printer.name: grid 3D printer
f_3d_printer.description: A 3D printer connected to a electrical grid.

f_3d_printer_advanced.name: grid 3D printer (advanced)
f_3d_printer_advanced.description: An advanced 3D printer connected to a electrical grid.

f_reloading_station.name: grid reloading press
f_reloading_station.description: An all-in-one handloading tool that can both assemble ammunition and break it back down for materials, includes a hotplate for bullet molding connected to an electrical grid.

f_olight_base.name: overhead light
f_olight_base.description: Abstract furniture.  If you see this, something went wrong.

f_olight_off.name: ceiling lamp (off)
f_olight_off.description: A working lamp installed on the ceiling, this one is turned off.
f_olight_off.message: You switched on the ceiling lamp.

f_olight_on.name: ceiling lamp (on)
f_olight_on.description: A working lamp installed on the ceiling, this one is turned on.
f_olight_on.message: You switched off the ceiling lamp.

transform.msg: The ceiling lamp flickers and dies.

f_olight.name: ceiling lamp (no power)
f_olight.description: A working lamp installed on the ceiling, this one is turned on but it has no power.
f_olight.message: You switched off the ceiling lamp.

f_light_switch.name: light switch (off)
f_light_switch.description: A light switch connected to your electrical grid, this one is turned off.

f_light_switch_on.name: light switch (on)
f_light_switch_on.description: A light switch connected to your electrical grid, this one is turned on.

f_adv_butchery.name: advanced butchering station
f_adv_butchery.description: An advanced butchering station connected to a electrical grid.

f_hydraulic_press.name: grid hydraulic press
f_hydraulic_press.description: If you really want to squash something a lot, this would be exactly the right industrial tool for you.

f_recycler.name: metal compactor
f_recycler.description: A hydraulic compactor that can accept items made of various metals, and press them into basic shapes, ready for further crafting.  If you're very careful, you can even uninstall it to transport it elsewhere.

f_cloning_vat.name: cloning vat
f_cloning_vat.description: A vat full of solution, probably intended to hold growing clones of people or other life forms.  Requires a steady, strong power supply to avoid failure.  Examine it to activate, requires a sterile artificial womb and viable DNA, the latter produced via a genome workstation from stored sample data off USB and sufficient growth medium.

f_cloning_vat_active.name: active cloning vat
f_cloning_vat_active.description: A vat full of solution, its surface rippling as bubbles rise to the top.  It hums softly, the liquid churning as if something inside is taking shape.

transform.msg: <color_red>The cloning vat shuts down unexpectedly, destroying the materials in the process.</color>

f_gridanalytical_set.name: grid basic analysis kit
f_gridanalytical_set.description: A basic laboratory analysis kit connected to an electrical grid, drawing power instead of batteries.  Its spectrophotometer, pH meter, and other instruments work just as well as the portable version.

f_gridmicrocentrifuge.name: grid microcentrifuge
f_gridmicrocentrifuge.description: A microcentrifuge connected to an electrical grid, drawing power instead of batteries.  Bench-sized but still very fast.

f_griddna_editor.name: grid genome workstation
f_griddna_editor.description: A genome workstation connected to an electrical grid, drawing power instead of batteries.  Can scan genetic samples and produce DNA samples for cloning.

f_barricade_road.name: road barricade
f_barricade_road.description: A road barricade.  For barricading roads.  You could stand next to it to fire past without it blocking your shots, not that it will slow them down much.

f_barricade_windbreak.name: simple wooden barricade
f_barricade_windbreak.description: A waist-high barricade made of stout saplings, held in place by poles hammered into the ground.  Useful to fence in a campsite and shelter a fire from the wind, or slow down intruders.

f_earthbag_half.name: earthbag barricade
f_earthbag_half.description: An earthbag barricade, typically used for blocking bullets.  Stand next to it to fire past it unimpeded.

f_lane.name: lane guard
f_lane.description: Used to be used for keeping traffic.

f_sandbag_half.name: sandbag barricade
f_sandbag_half.description: A sandbag barricade, typically used for blocking bullets.  Stand next to it to fire past it unimpeded.

f_bigmirror.name: standing mirror
f_bigmirror.description: Lookin' good - is that blood?  Examine it to practice the Speech skill and give yourself a pep talk.

f_bigmirror_b.name: broken standing mirror
f_bigmirror_b.description: You could look at yourself, if the mirror wasn't covered in cracks and fractures.

f_bitts.name: bitts
f_bitts.description: Paired vertical iron posts mounted on a wharf, pier or quay.  They are used to secure mooring lines, ropes, hawsers, or cables.

f_cleat.name: cleat
f_cleat.description: A small horn cleat with two “horns” extending parallel to the deck or the axis of the spar, and resembling a small anvil.  They are used to secure mooring lines, ropes, and similar.

f_shackle.name: manacles
f_shackle.description: Chain serfs in your dungeon.  All you need now is an iron ball to chain to it.

f_statue.name: statue
f_statue.description: A carved statue made of stone.

f_mannequin.name: mannequin
f_mannequin.description: Put clothes on it, talk to it.  Who's around to judge you?  Wait… did it just move?  Assuming it doesn't talk back, could be used to practice the Speech skill.

f_birdbath.name: birdbath
f_birdbath.description: A decorative cement birdbath and pedestal.

f_rotary_clothesline.name: rotary clothes dryer line
f_rotary_clothesline.description: A umbrella shaped clothes line mounted on a pole.

f_winter_wreath.name: pine wreath
f_winter_wreath.description: A decorative wreath for the winter holidays.

f_decorative_tree.name: decorative tree
f_decorative_tree.description: A decorative tree for the winter holidays.

t_dimensional_portal.name: dimensional portal
t_dimensional_portal.description: A shimmering aperture in space, held open by an arcane-industrial framework. Unlinked.

t_dimensional_portal_linked.name: dimensional portal (active)
t_dimensional_portal_linked.description: A shimmering aperture in space, held open by an arcane-industrial framework. Examining it will transport you to the linked dimension.

t_dimensional_portal_closed.name: dimensional portal (closed)
t_dimensional_portal_closed.description: The arcane-industrial framework of a dimensional portal, its aperture now sealed. The dimensional connection it once maintained has collapsed.

f_power_portal.name: power portal
f_power_portal.description: A large arcane-industrial apparatus that can form a persistent electrical bridge to a paired node, even across dimensional boundaries. Unlinked.

f_power_portal_linked.name: power portal (active)
f_power_portal_linked.description: A large arcane-industrial apparatus forming a persistent electrical bridge to a paired node. The hum of power flowing through the dimensional membrane is faintly audible.

f_power_portal_paused.name: power portal (paused)
f_power_portal_paused.description: A large arcane-industrial apparatus configured to form an electrical bridge, but currently inactive due to insufficient power or a manual pause.

f_indoor_plant.name: indoor plant
f_indoor_plant.description: A variety of plant, used for decoration.

f_indoor_plant_y.name: yellow indoor plant
f_indoor_plant_y.description: A variety of plant for decoration.  It's yellow.

f_plant_harvest.name: harvestable plant
f_plant_harvest.description: This plant is ready for harvest.  Examine it more closely to identify how to harvest the plant appropriately.

f_plant_seed.name: seed
f_plant_seed.description: A humble planted seed.  Actions are the seed of fate deeds grow into destiny.

f_plant_seedling.name: seedling
f_plant_seedling.description: This plant is just getting started.

f_planter.name: planter
f_planter.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  Can be used for planting crops.

f_planter_harvest.name: planter with harvestable plant
f_planter_harvest.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  Can be used for planting crops.  This one contains a planted seed

f_planter_mature.name: planter with maturing plant
f_planter_mature.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  Can be used for planting crops.  This one contains a planted seed

f_planter_seed.name: planter with seed
f_planter_seed.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  Can be used for planting crops.  This one contains a planted seed

f_planter_seedling.name: planter with seedling
f_planter_seedling.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  Can be used for planting crops.  This one contains a planted seedling

f_rack_mushroom.name: mushroom rack
f_rack_mushroom.description: A rack specifically made for raising mushrooms.  You can plant mushroom cultures in here.

f_rack_mushroom_seed.name: freshly-planted mushroom rack
f_rack_mushroom_seed.description: A rack specifically made for raising mushrooms.  This one contains a mushroom culture that was recently planted.

f_rack_mushroom_seedling.name: young mushroom rack
f_rack_mushroom_seedling.description: A rack specifically made for raising mushrooms.  This one contains a mushroom culture that's just started to grow.

f_rack_mushroom_mature.name: maturing mushroom rack
f_rack_mushroom_mature.description: A rack specifically made for raising mushrooms.  This one contains a growing mushroom culture, that'll be ready to harvest soon.

f_rack_mushroom_harvest.name: harvestable mushroom rack
f_rack_mushroom_harvest.description: A rack specifically made for raising mushrooms.  This one has mushrooms ready to be picked growing in it.

f_egg_sackbw.name: spider egg sack
f_egg_sackbw.description: Much too large, off-white egg sack.  Kind of icky.  Something IS moving in there.

f_egg_sackcs.name: spider egg sack
f_egg_sackcs.description: Bulbous mass of spider eggs.  More than kind of icky.  Something IS moving in there.

f_egg_sackws.name: spider egg sack
f_egg_sackws.description: A horrifyingly oversized egg sack.  Something IS moving in there.  If you're seeing this, you're already too close to it.

f_egg_sacke.name: ruptured egg sack
f_egg_sacke.description: Super icky.  Spider stuff's spilling out.

f_swamp_gas.name: swamp gas
f_swamp_gas.description: This is a pool of murky water, it occasionally bubbles, releasing a mildly toxic gas.

f_fog.name: fog
f_fog.description: This is a misty cloud of fog.

f_hot_spring.name: natural gas vent
f_hot_spring.description: A natural gas vent on the lake bed that is currently emitting heat.

f_metal_cold_vent.name: running ventilation shutters
f_metal_cold_vent.description: A large panel set into the reinforced metal wall.  Somehow still running despite the chaos, blasting a wave of bitterly cold air into the facility.

f_fake_bench_hands.name: fake workbench hands
f_fake_bench_hands.description: This fake workbench holds the stats for working on a wielded item.

f_ground_crafting_spot.name: ground crafting spot
f_ground_crafting_spot.description: A cleared spot on the ground for crafting.  Slower than using a workbench or holding a project in your hands, but readily available.

f_no_item.name: seeing this is a bug
f_no_item.description: Seeing this is a bug.  If seen, please report and destroy.

f_fireplace.name: fireplace
f_fireplace.description: Ah.  The relaxation of sitting in front of a fire as the world around you crumbles.  Towards the End, you could also get this service on your television.

f_woodstove.name: wood stove
f_woodstove.description: Wood stove for heating and cooking.  Much more efficient than an open flame.

f_brazier.name: brazier
f_brazier.description: A raised metal dish in which to safely burn things.

f_hobo_stove.name: hobo stove
f_hobo_stove.description: This is a small improvised wood stove, made from a metal can.  It's too small to fit anything much larger than splintered wood.

f_55gal_firebarrel.name: fire barrel (200L)
f_55gal_firebarrel.description: A large metal barrel used to contain a fire.  It has multiple holes punched in its walls for air supply.  Fires set in a fire barrel will not spread to surrounding flammable objects.

f_30gal_firebarrel.name: fire barrel (100L)
f_30gal_firebarrel.description: A large metal barrel used to contain a fire.  It has multiple holes punched in its walls for air supply.  Fires set in a fire barrel will not spread to surrounding flammable objects.

f_firering.name: fire ring
f_firering.description: A ring of stones to safely contain a fire.

f_mutpoppy.name: mutated poppy flower
f_mutpoppy.description: These strange flowers have appeared in the wake of the Cataclysm, and their buds can be used for medicinal purposes, like the seeds of the mundane poppy they're named after.  The dirt around them gently churns as their roots writhe beneath the soil, and it's surrounded by an overwhelming floral smell that makes you feel sleepy.

f_dandelion.name: dandelion
f_dandelion.description: A common weed with a yellow flower.  Produces seeds that get carried on the wind by thin, gray filaments.

f_burdock.name: burdock
f_burdock.description: A common weed with a purple thistle-like flower.  Its seeds tend to stick to clothing and fur.

f_flower_tulip.name: tulip
f_flower_tulip.description: A bright, colorful flower with petals forming a small cup at its top.

f_flower_spurge.name: spurge flower
f_flower_spurge.description: A yellow-green flower that grows in densely packed bushes.

f_cattails.name: cattails
f_cattails.description: This useful plant is available all year round.  Many parts of the plant are edible.

f_cattails_harvested.name: harvested cattails
f_cattails_harvested.description: This useful plant has been stripped of most of its stalks, and the easier-to-reach rhizomes have all been pulled up.

f_black_eyed_susan.name: black eyed susan
f_black_eyed_susan.description: A yellow flower that has a dark ball in the middle.  Sometimes known as an ox-eye daisy.

f_lily.name: lily
f_lily.description: A pretty flower that comes in a variety of colors.

f_lotus.name: lotus
f_lotus.description: A lovely flower that grows on the surface of bodies of freshwater.  Traditionally connected with many Eastern cultures.

f_sunflower.name: sunflower
f_sunflower.description: A tall, wide-headed flower with a large dark center.  Produces many nutritious seeds.

f_lilypad.name: lilypad
f_lilypad.description: These lilypads don't look they'd support the weight of the things you've heard croaking in the swamp.

f_dahlia.name: dahlia
f_dahlia.description: A puffy flower with many tightly layered petals.

f_chicory.name: chicory
f_chicory.description: A blue flower imported from Europe, also known as a Cornflower.

f_leaves_pile.name: pile of leaves
f_leaves_pile.description: A sizable pile of leaves.  You could sleep on it if you don't care about comfort or warmth.

f_mustard.name: mustard
f_mustard.description: Yellow flower known as Brassica Nigra.  Known for its seeds that can be used for making table mustard.

f_beaver_dam.name: dam
f_beaver_dam.description: A house that beavers built.  The entrance is underwater making it harder for predators to access.

f_lake_liverwort.name: liverwort
f_lake_liverwort.description: A species of liverwort that grows at the bottom of lakes.

f_lake_pondweed.name: pondweed
f_lake_pondweed.description: An aquatic pondweed, it's sort of tall and blocks your view.  Whether Potamogeton or Elodea, most varieties have edible shoots that are best picked early in the year.

f_lake_eelgrass.name: eelgrass
f_lake_eelgrass.description: A species of eelgrass that grows at the bottom of lakes.

f_lake_hornwort.name: hornwort
f_lake_hornwort.description: A species of hornwort that grows at the bottom of lakes.  Though known for being harmful to other plants, the leaves are safe for humans to eat and available most of the year.

f_lake_detritus.name: detritus
f_lake_detritus.description: A mass of decaying organic matter that accumulates at the bottom of lakes.

f_cave_mushrooms.name: cave mushrooms
f_cave_mushrooms.description: A cluster of fungi growing in the dark.  Could be plucked, they might be edible.

f_flower_marloss.name: marloss flower
f_flower_marloss.description: This flower is like the other flowers taken by the mushrooms, but its bulb is colored a brilliant cyan color, and it emits an aroma both overwhelming and… delicious?

f_flower_fungal.name: fungal flower
f_flower_fungal.description: This flower has been overgrown by gray, sinewy tendrils of fungus, and the color has leached from its petals and stem.  It gently sways of its own volition.

f_fungal_mass.name: fungal mass
f_fungal_mass.description: Thick ropes of mycal matter have covered the ground here completely.  It's soft to the touch, but you sink into it, making moving across it difficult.

f_fungal_clump.name: fungal clump
f_fungal_clump.description: Alien mold and stems mingle tightly here, creating a sort of fungal bush.

f_fungal_tangle.name: fungal tangle
f_fungal_tangle.description: Thick, ropy tendrils of fungus have risen from the ground and gathered into an impenetrable clump.

f_slab.name: stone slab
f_slab.description: A flat slab of heavy stone.

f_grave_monument.name: obelisk
f_grave_monument.description: A monument to the fallen, from a time when the dead weren't so restless.

f_robotic_assembler.name: robotic assembler
f_robotic_assembler.description: A durable and versatile robotic arm with a tool fitted to the end, for working on an assembly line.

f_chemical_mixer.description: When chemicals need to be mixed in large quantities at just the right combinations and temperatures, this is the tool for the job.
f_chemical_mixer.name: chemical mixer

f_robotic_arm.name: robotic arm
f_robotic_arm.description: Automation!  Science!  Industry!  Make a better horse!  This robot arm promises to do it all.  Except it's currently unpowered.  You could remove the casing and retrieve the electronics through disassembly, or ifyou get power running it could help practice the Fabrication skill.

f_steam_turbine.name: steam turbine
f_steam_turbine.description: Coal, natural gas, nuclear power, it all boiled down (pun intended) to generating power with steam in the end.  Could be salvaged, if you have any steamboats in need of a lightly-used engine.

f_control_station.name: control station
f_control_station.description: Assorted electronic interfaces and screens.  You could scavenge it for parts, or get power going and use it to practice Electronics.

f_electrical_conduit.name: electrical conduit
f_electrical_conduit.description: A thick bundle of electrical wiring protected by a metal conduit.  Could be useful for practicing your Electronics skill.

f_capacitor.name: capacitor bank
f_capacitor.description: A bank of heavy metal cylinders connected by large wires.  Could be useful for practicing your Electronics skill.

f_wind_turbine_rotor.name: wind turbine rotor assembly
f_wind_turbine_rotor.description: A large, bladed turbine meant for generating power from wind.  Spinning idly in the breeze, it could be connected to and provide power to a base built nearby.  The turbine could be salvaged for local power generation elsewhere instead, but it would provide far less power than a fully-operational dedicated turbine.

f_water_wheel_turbine.name: hydroelectric turbine assembly
f_water_wheel_turbine.description: A huge turbine meant for generating power from flowing water.  What's left of it is a far cry from the megawatts of power it used to output, but it could still be hooked up to provide power to a nearby base.  Alternatively, it could be salvaged for parts that could be used for power generation elsewhere.

f_supercomputer.name: supercomputer
f_supercomputer.description: This massive array of panels and screens used to be the focal point of what was slated to be the bleeding-edge in quantum computing.  A few display screens still flit through an endless loop of error messages, but whatever its original purpose was has long since been completely scrambled by the Cataclysm.  With more power you could connect to what's left of old server data to train Computer skill, otherwise it's only good for very valuable scrap.

f_cvdmachine.name: CVD control panel
f_cvdmachine.description: This is a VERY expensive-looking apparatus that's labeled 'Chemical Vapor Deposition Machine'.  With the input of certain exceptionally rare chemicals and elements, one could conceivably coat one's weapon with diamond.  While the process is extremely complicated, a previous user has helpfully sketched: Hydrogen + charcoal = smiley face.

f_autodoc.name: Autodoc Mk. XI
f_autodoc.description: A surgical apparatus used for installation and removal of bionics.  It's only as skilled as its operator.

f_autodoc_couch.name: Autodoc operation couch
f_autodoc_couch.description: A plush red sofa made less comfortable by the medical machinery directly above it.  It has a single leather strap on the right armrest.

f_autoclave.name: laboratory autoclave
f_autoclave.description: This thing is basically an extremely high tech laundry machine or dishwasher.  It steams things at temperatures that will kill almost anything.  It could be used to mend faulty bionics that need sterilization.

f_sample_freezer.name: sample freezer
f_sample_freezer.description: When cold just isn't cold enough, you have this extreme deep freeze.  This will store stuff at -80 degrees Celsius.  Don't lick the metal on the inside.

f_lab_bench.name: lab workbench
f_lab_bench.description: A metal storage cabinet topped by a durable resin countertop resistant to most chemical spills and burns.  It has wired in electrical and gas fittings.

f_fume_hood.description: A metal hood overtop of a lab workspace, with durable glass shutters.  A fan in the hood draws fumes and smoke from dangerous chemicals up into a ventilation duct.
f_fume_hood.name: fume hood

f_shaker.name: shaker incubator
f_shaker.description: A tool for keeping broth nicely mixed, at just the right temperature to grow bacteria.  This is great for microbiology, but terrible for preserving food.

f_eyewash.name: emergency wash station
f_eyewash.description: This pole has a lot of weird nozzles and attachments.  If there were running water, you could use those attachments to wash harmful chemicals out of your eyes, or to take a pleasant cold shower in a public place.

f_IV_pole.name: IV pole
f_IV_pole.description: This is basically just a stick on wheels with some hooks at the top.

f_HPLC.name: high performance liquid chromatographer
f_HPLC.description: This high-tech tool would, with electricity and an experienced user, be a very useful way to separate chemicals in a liquid or aqueous phase based on their affinity to a solid state medium in a tube.  In other words, it's a fancy way to separate things.

f_GC.name: gas chromatographer
f_GC.description: This high-tech tool would, with electricity and an experienced user, be a very useful way to separate chemicals in a gaseous phase based on their affinity to a solid state medium in a tube.  In other words, it's a fancy way to separate things.

f_MS.name: mass spectrometer
f_MS.description: Inside this thing is a carefully balanced set of electric field generators that can precisely separate ionized particles based on their charge-to-mass ratio, firing them into a detector that measures the exact mass of the particle hitting it.  On the outside, it looks like a very boring white box.

f_NMR.name: nuclear magnetic resonance spectrometer
f_NMR.description: This is a giant electromagnet in a kind of sci-fi looking housing.  Somehow it can be used to wiggle molecular bonds or something, and from there, look at the deepest inner workings of chemical structures!  Magnets: how do they work?

f_electron_microscope.name: electron microscope
f_electron_microscope.description: An enormous tool for using electron reflections off a surface to see what very tiny things look like.  Amazing for taking gross pictures of bugs.

f_CTscan.name: CT scanner
f_CTscan.description: This giant donut can take hundreds of x-rays in rapid sequence, making a really cool looking picture of all your innards that have varying degrees of radio-opacity.

f_MRI.name: MRI machine
f_MRI.description: This thing is really an NMR that you stick a person into, but people weren't excited about getting into a tiny hole in a loud machine called a 'nuclear magnetic resonance imager', so they changed it.

f_scan_bed.name: scanner bed
f_scan_bed.description: This is a narrow, uncomfortable bed for putting someone into an imaging machine or other small hole.

f_anesthetic.name: anesthetic machine
f_anesthetic.description: Keeping a person at just the right level of asleep to do surgery is hard.  This machine helps an anesthesiologist keep the right mix of drugs and air to keep a patient asleep.

f_dialysis.name: dialysis machine
f_dialysis.description: If your kidneys don't work, this is a large and inconvenient machine that can do the job instead!  It's super useful in the apocalypse, especially with how it requires power, tons of supplies, and a trained operator.

f_ventilator.name: medical ventilator
f_ventilator.description: When they talk about the 'breathing machine' that you don't want to wind up stuck on, this is what they mean.  It just looks like a couple boxes on a trolley.

f_centrifuge.name: centrifuge
f_centrifuge.description: This is a centrifuge, a liquid separating device with an automated analyzer unit.  For some reason, this one has an attached battery pack.  It could be used to analyze a medical fluid sample, such as blood, if a test tube was placed in it.    It could also be used for separating and analyzing other samples, if you have a use for that.

f_surgical_laser.name: surgical laser
f_surgical_laser.description: This is a large box with a handheld stylus connected to it with a flexible tube.  With power and a trained operator, it could cut and cauterize tissue using focused light.  You can take it apart for electronics.

f_alien_tendril.name: glowing tendril
f_alien_tendril.description: A willowy tendril growing from the floor, gently waving back and forth.  A faint illumination spills from it.

f_alien_anemone.name: wafting anemone
f_alien_anemone.description: A fleshy white protuberance growing from the floor, with a cluster of tendrils pouring out of it.  It looks almost exactly like a sea anemone, even waving gently as though in the water.

f_alien_anemone_clogged.name: clogged-up wafting anemone
f_alien_anemone_clogged.description: A fleshy white protuberance growing from the floor, with a cluster of tendrils pouring out of it.  Someone's sabotaged it, pouring alien resin over its tendrils to halt its emissions.

f_alien_gasper.name: gasping tube
f_alien_gasper.description: This is a meaty green stalactite with a thickened hide like that of a starfish, extending from the floor to the ceiling.  In the center is a series of ports somewhat like mouths, from which pour bursts of a vile smelling gas.

f_alien_gasper_clogged.name: clogged-up gasping tube
f_alien_gasper_clogged.description: This is a meaty green stalactite with a thickened hide like that of a starfish.  Someone's sabotaged it, pouring alien resin into every hole they could find to grind its constant noxious emissions to a near-halt.

f_alien_zapper.name: twitching frond
f_alien_zapper.description: A spine like the antenna of a moth juts from the ground, swaying gently in the air.  Every so often, a cascade of energy arcs along it and discharges into the ceiling.

f_alien_scar.name: scarred lump
f_alien_scar.description: This is a pile of unidentified twitching alien flesh, belching strange gases out of injured vessels.

f_alien_scar_clogged.name: clogged-up scarred lump
f_alien_scar_clogged.description: This is a pile of unidentified twitching alien flesh.  Someone's done even more to sabotage it, plugging this gaping wound in the alien hive full of resin to stop it from leaking alien gases.

f_alien_scar_small.name: seeping scar
f_alien_scar_small.description: This is a small patch of mangled alien flesh, wisps of strange gases leaking out of collapsed tissue.

f_alien_scar_small_clogged.name: clogged-up scarred lump
f_alien_scar_small_clogged.description: This is a small patch of mangled alien flesh, sabotaged even further by being given a heavy coating of resin to stop it from leaking noxius gases.

f_alien_pod.name: slimy pod
f_alien_pod.description: This is a slick, translucent pod suspended on a thin stalk.  It is covered in a thick mucus, obscuring whatever is floating in the gel-like substance inside.  You could fairly easily tear it from the stalk and see if anything is inside.

f_alien_pod_organ.name: organ pod
f_alien_pod_organ.description: This is a translucent pod suspended on a thin stalk.  Inside you can see the dimly outlined shape of human organs, floating in some kind of preservative goo.  You could fairly easily tear it from the stalk and see if anything is inside.

f_alien_pod_resin.name: resin pod
f_alien_pod_resin.description: This is a translucent pod suspended on a thin stalk.  Inside is a clean, clear resinous-looking fluid.  You could fairly easily tear it from the stalk and take it with you.

f_alien_table.name: fleshy altar
f_alien_table.description: This pulsing protuberance juts from the floor, its sides covered in scaled, oozing skin.  The surface is flat, but undulates softly.  A handful of unidentifiable appendages reach from the sides, suggesting a sort of nightmarish living autodoc.

f_alien_nerve.name: nerve cluster
f_alien_nerve.description: A bundle of molded resin encasing alien flesh, connected to the ceiling by thick bundles of nerves.  It must control some part of this alien structure, tearing the right piece out might short something.  Then again, the way it breathes and twitches suggests it might be risky to mess with…

f_bathtub.name: bathtub
f_bathtub.description: You could lay in and take a soothing bath, if there were running water.  The plug is intact, so you could use it to store liquids.

f_shower.name: shower
f_shower.description: You would be able to clean yourself if water was running.  Soap, detergent, or bleach could help with a thorough wash.

f_sink.name: sink
f_sink.description: Emergency relief provider.  Water isn't running, so it's basically useless.

f_toilet.name: toilet
f_toilet.description: A porcelain throne.  Emergency water source, from the tank, and provider of relief.

f_water_heater.name: water heater
f_water_heater.description: An insulated metal tank that holds water, kept to a temperature by a small gas flame.

f_water_dispenser.name: water dispenser
f_water_dispenser.description: A machine with several taps that dispenses clean water.  Also known as a water cooler, it's still useful so long as the tank is full.

f_water_purifier_off.name: water purifier (off)
f_water_purifier_off.description: This removes ions dissolved in the water, making it pretty clean, if you care about that kind of thing.  It is hooked into a fluid grid and switched off.
f_water_purifier_off.message: You switch on the water purifier.

f_water_purifier.name: water purifier
f_water_purifier.description: This removes ions dissolved in the water, making it pretty clean, if you care about that kind of thing.  It is hooked into a fluid grid.
f_water_purifier.message: You switch off the water purifier.

f_water_purifier_on.name: water purifier (on)
f_water_purifier_on.description: This removes ions dissolved in the water, making it pretty clean, if you care about that kind of thing.  It is hooked into a fluid grid and switched on.
f_water_purifier_on.message: You switch off the water purifier.

f_electric_well_pump_off.name: electric well pump (off)
f_electric_well_pump_off.description: An electric well pump connected to a fluid grid.  It is switched off.
f_electric_well_pump_off.prompt: Switch on the electric well pump.
f_electric_well_pump_off.message: You switch on the electric well pump.

f_electric_well_pump.name: electric well pump
f_electric_well_pump.description: An electric well pump connected to a fluid grid.  It has no power.
f_electric_well_pump.prompt: Switch off the electric well pump.
f_electric_well_pump.message: You switch off the electric well pump.

transform.msg: The electric well pump starts up.

f_electric_well_pump_on.name: electric well pump (on)
f_electric_well_pump_on.description: An electric well pump connected to a fluid grid.  It is switched on.
f_electric_well_pump_on.prompt: Switch off the electric well pump.
f_electric_well_pump_on.message: You switch off the electric well pump.

transform.msg: The electric well pump shuts down.

f_rain_collector_plumbed.name: rain collector (plumbed)
f_rain_collector_plumbed.description: A plumbed rain collector that feeds a fluid grid when it is raining.

f_exercise.name: exercise machine
f_exercise.description: Typically used for, well, exercising.  You're getting quite enough of that; running for your life.  If you feel like pumping iron anyway, examine it to practice Athletics.

f_ball_mach.name: ball machine
f_ball_mach.description: An unpowered machine that seems like it could've been used to launch various balls for different types of sports.  It's mostly just good for parts if disassembled, but with grid power it could be used to practice Dodging.

f_pool_table.name: pool table
f_pool_table.description: A good-looking pool table.  You wish you learned how to play.

f_target.name: steel target
f_target.description: A metal shooting target in the rough shape of a human, that tips over when shot.  Or you could examine it to tip it over by hand, if you want.
f_target.message: You knock the steel target over.  How fun.

f_target_downed.name: toppled steel target
f_target_downed.description: A metal shooting target in the rough shape of a human.  It's been knocked over by a good hit, examine it to stand it back up.
f_target_downed.message: You prop the steel target back up.

f_arcade_machine.name: arcade machine
f_arcade_machine.description: Play stupid games, win stupid prizes.  That was the idea, anyway.  Now, without power, it's just stupid.  Smarter to disassemble for all kinds of useful electronic parts.

f_pinball_machine.name: pinball machine
f_pinball_machine.description: Most underrated game of the 20th century.  Press buttons so the ball doesn't go in the hole.  It doesn't seem to be working without electricity.  Could be disassembled for various electronic parts.

f_ergometer.name: ergometer
f_ergometer.description: A rowing exercise machine, might have useful parts in it.  Examine it to practice your Athletics skill.

f_treadmill.name: treadmill
f_treadmill.description: Used for training leg muscles.  Could be taken apart for its… parts.  You could use it to practice Athletics, but this will require restoring power to it.

f_punching_bag.name: heavy punching bag
f_punching_bag.description: Punch Punch!  Exercise those arms!  Main selling point: it doesn't fight back!  Examine it to practice your Unarmed skill.

f_piano.name: piano
f_piano.description: The ol' ebony and ivory.  Really classes up the place.  You could take it apart if you wanted… you monster.

f_speaker_cabinet.name: speaker cabinet
f_speaker_cabinet.description: A cabinet loaded with 12-inch speakers, intended to help make various things loud.  It can't serve its original purpose these days, but it could be disassembled for various electronic parts.

f_dancing_pole.name: dancing pole
f_dancing_pole.description: Tall metal pole meant for dancing, attached on bottom and top.  Could practice your Dodging skill with it, if you're feeling expressive.

f_organ.name: pipe organ
f_organ.description: A majestic pipe organ.  Dubbed "the king of instruments", it is capable of producing powerful sound harmonies if used by a skilled player.  Rows of off-white and black keys all linked to a set of iron pipes, which resonate at a specific pitch when pressurized air is driven through them.

f_region_flower.name: this should never actually show up, it's a pseudo furniture
f_region_flower.description: this should never actually show up, it's a pseudo furniture

f_region_weed.name: this should never actually show up, it's a pseudo furniture
f_region_weed.description: this should never actually show up, it's a pseudo furniture

f_region_water_plant.name: this should never actually show up, it's a pseudo furniture
f_region_water_plant.description: this should never actually show up, it's a pseudo furniture

f_region_flower_decorative.name: this should never actually show up, it's a pseudo furniture
f_region_flower_decorative.description: this should never actually show up, it's a pseudo furniture

f_cellphone_booster.name: cell phone signal booster
f_cellphone_booster.description: A cell phone signal booster, it may be useful for parts now.  If you can get power running to it, tinkering with it would let you practice your Electronics skill.

f_small_satelitte_dish.name: satellite dish
f_small_satelitte_dish.description: A small satellite dish for home entertainment.  If you can get power running to it, tinkering with it would let you practice your Electronics skill.

f_chimney.name: chimney crown
f_chimney.description: The top of a chimney, it looks sooty.

f_TV_antenna.name: TV antenna
f_TV_antenna.description: The television antenna improved reception for televisions.

f_vent_pipe.name: vent pipe
f_vent_pipe.description: The plumbing vent pipe removes gas and odors from the building.

f_roof_turbine_vent.name: roof turbine vent
f_roof_turbine_vent.description: The turbine uses wind power to suck hot and humid air out of the attic.

f_hay.name: bale of hay
f_hay.description: A bale of hay.  You could sleep on it, if desperate.

f_woodchips.name: pile of woodchips
f_woodchips.description: Pile of chipped wood pieces.  You can move it with a shovel.

f_hive_young.name: empty beehive
f_hive_young.description: A traditional beehive, baited to attract bees.  It will take a while before any bees decide to make use of it.

f_hive_growing.name: growing beehive
f_hive_growing.description: A traditional beehive, buzzing with slight activity.  Some bees have started work on this hive, but it won't be ready just yet.

f_hive_ready.name: mature beehive
f_hive_ready.description: A traditional beehive, buzzing with activity.  The colony is doing well enough that you could harvest a good amount without the hive dying off, except during the winter.

f_hive_recovering.name: recovering beehive
f_hive_recovering.description: A traditional beehive, buzzing with activity.  The colony is still recovering from last harvest.

f_bench.name: bench
f_bench.description: Hobo bed.  Airy.  Use at your own risk.  You could also examine to flip it onto its side as an obstacle.
f_bench.message: You kick the bench over onto its side.

f_bench_flipped.name: flipped bench
f_bench_flipped.description: Hobo bed, now with extra hostile architecture.  Examine it to make it actually suitable to sleep on.
f_bench_flipped.message: You set the bench back upright.

f_armchair.name: arm chair
f_armchair.description: A more comfortable way of sitting down.

f_seat_airplane.name: airplane seat
f_seat_airplane.description: An airplane seat with a seatbelt.

f_sofa.name: sofa
f_sofa.description: Lie down OR sit down!  Perfect!

f_camp_chair.name: camp chair
f_camp_chair.description: Sit down, have a drink.  It can folded for easy transportation.

f_logstool.name: log stool
f_logstool.description: A log tipped on its end with any rough edges cut off.  Basically a very simple seat.

f_deckchair.name: deck chair
f_deckchair.description: A comfortable deck chair for sunbathing.  If only you had time for that.

f_metal_bench.name: metal bench
f_metal_bench.description: A bench made of scrap metal.  Not the most comfortable furniture you've ever seen.  Examine it to knock it over to present more of an obstacle.
f_metal_bench.message: You kick the metal bench over onto its side.

f_metal_bench_flipped.name: flipped metal bench
f_metal_bench_flipped.description: A bench made of scrap metal, now even more uncomfortable being used as low cover.  Examine it to reorient it for using as proper furniture.
f_metal_bench_flipped.message: You set the metal bench back upright.

f_chair_folding.name: folding chair
f_chair_folding.description: A black foldable plastic chair on a steel frame.  Not particularly comfortable, but at least you have something to sit on.

f_bulletin.name: bulletin board
f_bulletin.description: A big, cork bulletin board capable of sporting various notices.  Pin some notes for other survivors to read.

f_sign_warning.name: warning sign
f_sign_warning.description: A triangle-shaped sign on a post meant to indicate something important or hazard.

f_bed.name: bed
f_bed.description: This is a bed.  A luxury in these times.  Quite comfortable to sleep in.

f_bunkbed.name: bunk bed
f_bunkbed.description: A wooden bunk bed with mattresses for two people.

f_triple_bunkbed.name: triple berth
f_triple_bunkbed.description: This bunk bed can hold 3 person at once - perfect solution for places with lack of free space.

f_bed_frame.name: bed frame
f_bed_frame.description: This is an empty bed frame.  With a mattress on it, it would be a nice place to sleep.  Sleeping on it right now wouldn't be great.

f_floor_mattress.name: mattress
f_floor_mattress.description: A comfortable mattress has been tossed on the floor for sleeping here.  It's not quite as comfy as a real bed, but it's pretty close.

f_down_mattress.name: down mattress
f_down_mattress.description: A comfortable feather down mattress has been tossed on the floor for sleeping here.  It's not quite as comfy as a real bed, but it's pretty close.

f_makeshift_bed.name: makeshift bed
f_makeshift_bed.description: Not as comfortable as a real bed, but it will suffice.

f_straw_bed.name: straw bed
f_straw_bed.description: Kinda itches when you lay on it.

f_wool_mattress.name: wool mattress
f_wool_mattress.description: A comfortable wool mattress has been tossed on the floor for sleeping here.  It's not quite as comfy as a real bed, but it's pretty close.

f_bathtub_money.name: bathtub full of money
f_bathtub_money.description: You could lay in and take a soothing bath, if there were running water.  Instead, you have a bathtub full of cash.  Now you can lay in it and take a scrooge mcduck-style slumber.

f_bookcase.name: bookcase
f_bookcase.description: Stores books.  Y'know, those things.  Who reads books anymore?

f_entertainment_center.name: entertainment center
f_entertainment_center.description: Stores audio visual equipment, books and collectibles.

f_coffin_c.name: coffin
f_coffin_c.description: Holds the bodies of the countless killed in the Cataclysm.

pry.fail_message: You pry, but the coffin remains closed.

f_coffin_o.name: open coffin
f_coffin_o.description: You can only hope you'll look good enough for one of these, when the time comes.

f_crate_c.name: crate
f_crate_c.description: What's inside?  Pry it open to find out!  Or just smash it, but you might break the contents.

pry.fail_message: You pry, but cannot pop open the crate.

f_cardboard_box.name: large cardboard box
f_cardboard_box.description: A large cardboard box: this could be used to store things, or as a hiding place.

f_dresser.name: dresser
f_dresser.description: Dress yourself for the zombie prom, or other occasions.

f_glass_cabinet.name: glass front cabinet
f_glass_cabinet.description: A tall storage cabinet with a clear glass window.

f_gunsafe_o.name: open gun safe
f_gunsafe_o.description: A large and heavy container with thick metal walls and a rotary combination lock, this is designed to securely store firearms, weapon mods, and ammunition.

f_gunsafe_c.name: closed gun safe
f_gunsafe_c.description: A large and heavy container with thick metal walls and a rotary combination lock, this is designed to securely store firearms, weapon mods, and ammunition.

f_gunsafe_ml.name: gun safe
f_gunsafe_ml.lockpick_message: With a satisfying click, the lock on the gun safe door opens.

pry.fail_message: You pry, but cannot pry open the safe.
pry.break_message: Your clumsy attempt jams the safe!

f_gunsafe_mj.name: jammed gun safe
f_gunsafe_mj.description: Does it have guns in it?  You won't find out.  It's jammed.

f_gun_safe_el.name: electronic gun safe
f_gun_safe_el.description: Can you hack it open to get the firearms?

pry.fail_message: You pry, but cannot pry open the safe.
pry.break_message: Your clumsy attempt jams the safe!

f_locker.name: locker
f_locker.description: Usually used for storing equipment or items.

f_mailbox.name: mailbox
f_mailbox.description: A metal box attached to the top of a wooden post.  Mail delivery hasn't come for awhile.  Doesn't look like it's coming again anytime soon.

f_clothing_rail.name: clothing rail
f_clothing_rail.description: A rail for hanging clothes on.

f_rack_wood.name: wooden rack
f_rack_wood.description: A simple wooden rack.  Display your items on it.

f_rack_coat.name: coat rack
f_rack_coat.description: A hooked rack for hanging jackets and hats.

pry.fail_message: You pry, but cannot pry open the safe.

f_trashcan.name: trash can
f_trashcan.description: One man's trash is another man's dinner.  Examine it to take down, if you need an improvised bucket.

f_wardrobe.name: wardrobe
f_wardrobe.description: A tall piece of furniture - basically a freestanding closet.

f_filing_cabinet.name: filing cabinet
f_filing_cabinet.description: A set of drawers in a sturdy metal cabinet, used to hold files.  It can be locked to protect important information.  If you're lucky, there are often keys nearby.

f_utility_shelf.name: utility shelf
f_utility_shelf.description: A simple heavy-duty plastic and metal shelving unit.

f_warehouse_shelf.name: warehouse shelf
f_warehouse_shelf.description: A large, sturdy shelf made of metal for storing pallets and crates in warehouses.

f_wood_keg.name: wooden keg
f_wood_keg.description: A keg made mostly of wood.  Holds liquids, preferably alcoholic.

f_displaycase.name: display case
f_displaycase.description: Display your stuff fancily and securely.
f_displaycase.lockpick_message: With a satisfying click, the display case slides open.

pry.success_message: You pry open the display case.
pry.fail_message: You pry, but cannot pry open the display.

f_displaycase_b.name: broken display case
f_displaycase_b.description: Display your stuff.  It'll get stolen.

f_displaycase_o.name: unlocked display case
f_displaycase_o.description: Display your stuff.  Not very secure anymore, but still looks nice.

f_standing_tank.name: standing tank
f_standing_tank.description: A large freestanding metal tank, useful for holding liquids.

f_standing_tank_plumbed.name: standing tank (plumbed)
f_standing_tank_plumbed.description: A large freestanding metal tank hooked into a fluid grid.

f_clay_storage.name: clay water pots
f_clay_storage.description: Four large water pots together in a corner, holding up to 150 liters of a single type of liquid.  It is quite fragile but can be constructed and removed without tools.

f_dumpster.name: dumpster
f_dumpster.description: Stores trash.  Doesn't get picked up anymore.  Note the smell.

f_atomic_butter_churn.name: atomic butter churn on a stand
f_atomic_butter_churn.description: The Rivtech Atomic Butter Churn in deployed state.  It hums menacingly.  Ready to add raw milk and salt.  It will churn till the earth is a cinder.

f_foot_locker.name: metal foot locker
f_foot_locker.description: A metal storage box, capable of holding any number of things.  The lid has has a small lock.

f_chest.name: wooden chest
f_chest.description: A nice big wooden box with a hinged lid, to store all manner of things in.

f_counter.name: counter
f_counter.description: Affixed to the wall or found in kitchens or stores.

f_counter_gate_c.name: closed counter gate
f_counter_gate_c.description: A commercial quality swinging door made of wood that allows passage behind counters.

f_counter_gate_o.name: open counter gate
f_counter_gate_o.description: A commercial quality swinging door made of wood that allows passage behind counters.

f_desk.name: desk
f_desk.description: Sit down at it or work on it.

f_workbench.name: workbench
f_workbench.description: A sturdy workbench built out of metal.  It is perfect for crafting large and heavy things.

f_survivors_workbench.name: survivor workbench
f_survivors_workbench.description: A sturdy workbench built out of metal.  It is perfect for crafting large and heavy things.  This one contains a few extra tools and supplies, making it more useful than a standard workbench.

f_robobench.name: robotic workbench
f_robobench.description: Having upgraded the basic workbench, you've now created a robotic workbench that helps speed up crafting.

f_leather_tarp.name: leather tarp
f_leather_tarp.description: A large sheet of sewn leather that can be used instead of a picnic blanket, but it's more valuable as a butchery appliance as it does not soak in blood.

f_plastic_groundsheet.name: plastic groundsheet
f_plastic_groundsheet.description: A large sheet of thick plastic has been tossed on the ground here.  It would be a useful place to do some butchery, perhaps.

f_fiber_mat.name: fiber mat
f_fiber_mat.description: A large mat woven from fibrous material that can be used instead of a picnic blanket, but it's more valuable as a butchery appliance.  Too thin to be a comfortable sleeping place.

f_tourist_table.name: tourist table
f_tourist_table.description: Small metal folding table, ideal for off-road trips into the wild.  Can be used as a workbench in a pinch, or tipped over to create a more solid obstacle.
f_tourist_table.message: You knock the tourist table onto its side.

f_tourist_table_flipped.name: flipped tourist table
f_tourist_table_flipped.description: This little metal table looks like a bear's had lunch off it.  Examine it to set it back upright to be less of a tripping hazard.
f_tourist_table_flipped.message: You set the tourist table back upright.

f_table.name: table
f_table.description: Sit down when you eat!  Examine to flip it on its side if you're feeling angry, or want a barricade in a hurry.
f_table.message: You flip the table onto its side.

f_table_flipped.name: flipped table
f_table_flipped.description: Not so good for eating on, but will buy you a few more seconds before the zombies eat you.  Examine to set it back up for more civilized uses.
f_table_flipped.message: You set the table back on its feet.

f_coffee_table.name: coffee table
f_coffee_table.description: a low table for livingrooms.  Examine it to tip it onto its side, to slow down the horde in a pinch.
f_coffee_table.message: You kick the coffee table onto its side.

f_coffee_table_flipped.name: flipped coffee table
f_coffee_table_flipped.description: a low table knocked onto its side.  Examine to upright it.
f_coffee_table_flipped.message: You tip the coffee table back onto its feet.

f_tatami.name: tatami mat
f_tatami.description: A tatami is a type of mat used as a flooring material in traditional Japanese-style rooms.

f_pillow_fort.name: pillow fort
f_pillow_fort.description: A comfy place to hide from the world.  Not very defensible, though.

f_cardboard_fort.name: cardboard fort
f_cardboard_fort.description: A fort built by tipping a cardboard box on its side, lining it with blankets, and partly weather sealing it with a plastic sheet.

f_cardboard_wall.name: cardboard wall
f_cardboard_wall.description: This is a pile of cardboard boxes that have been filled with rags and junk and stacked together like bricks to form a wall.

f_cardboard_floor.name: cardboard floor
f_cardboard_floor.description: A flat floor made of sheets of cardboard duct-taped together overtop a plastic sheet.

f_cardboard_roof.name: cardboard roof
f_cardboard_roof.description: A sloped roof made of cardboard boxes, stuffed with scrap cardboard and paper and layered atop each other.  Sheets of plastic are carefully arrayed on top to shed water.  It looks like it could last a season or two at least before crumbling.

f_cardboard_door_o.name: cardboard door
f_cardboard_door_o.description: This is a pile of cardboard boxes that have been filled with rags and junk and stacked together like bricks to form a wall.  The largest box has been cut open and folded to form a makeshift door, which is open.

f_cardboard_door.name: cardboard door
f_cardboard_door.description: This is a pile of cardboard boxes that have been filled with rags and junk and stacked together like bricks to form a wall.  The largest box has been cut open and folded to form a makeshift door, which is closed.

f_beaded_door.name: beaded curtain
f_beaded_door.description: This beaded curtain could be pulled aside.

f_beaded_door_o.name: open beaded curtain
f_beaded_door_o.description: This beaded curtain has been pulled aside.

f_canvas_floor.name: canvas floor
f_canvas_floor.description: Flooring made out of stretched, waterproof cloth.  Helps keep the dirt out of the tent.

f_skylight_canvas_floor.name: skylight canvas floor
f_skylight_canvas_floor.description: Flooring made out of stretched, waterproof cloth.  Helps keep the dirt out of the tent. Has a plastic skylight to let light

f_canvas_wall.name: canvas wall
f_canvas_wall.description: A wall made of stretched, waterproof cloth and supported by wooden or metal stakes.

f_large_canvas_wall.name: heavy-duty canvas wall
f_large_canvas_wall.description: A wall made of stretched, waterproof cloth and supported by wooden or metal stakes. It has been strenghtened with plastic sheets.

f_canvas_door.name: canvas flap
f_canvas_door.description: This canvas flap door could be pulled aside. If you examine it closely, you could peek outside.

f_canvas_door_o.name: open canvas flap
f_canvas_door_o.description: This canvas flap door has been pulled aside.

f_large_canvas_door.name: heavy-duty canvas flap
f_large_canvas_door.description: This canvas flap door could be pulled aside. If you examine it closely, you could peek outside.

f_large_canvas_door_o.name: open heavy-duty canvas flap
f_large_canvas_door_o.description: This canvas flap door has been pulled aside.

f_groundsheet.name: groundsheet
f_groundsheet.description: This plastic groundsheet could keep you dry.

f_large_groundsheet.name: groundsheet
f_large_groundsheet.description: This large plastic groundsheet could keep you dry.

f_center_groundsheet.name: groundsheet
f_center_groundsheet.description: This plastic groundsheet could keep you dry.

f_fema_groundsheet.name: groundsheet
f_fema_groundsheet.description: This plastic government-issue groundsheet could keep you dry, but was made by the lowest bidder.

f_skin_wall.name: animalskin wall
f_skin_wall.description: Wall made out of animal skin.  Either an amazing or horrifying sight.

f_skin_door.name: animalskin flap
f_skin_door.description: This animal skin flap could be pulled aside.

f_skin_door_o.name: open animalskin flap
f_skin_door_o.description: This animal skin flap has been pulled aside.

f_skin_groundsheet.name: animalskin floor
f_skin_groundsheet.description: This animal skin groundsheet could keep you dry.

f_rubble.name: pile of rubble
f_rubble.description: Pile of various metals, bricks, and other building materials.  You could clear it with a shovel.

f_rubble_landfill.name: pile of trashy rubble
f_rubble_landfill.description: Trash topped with dirt and grass, it smells gross, but another man's trash…

f_rubble_water.name: pile of floating trash
f_rubble_water.description: Trash floating in the water. I guess it really does all end up here...

f_wreckage.name: metal wreckage
f_wreckage.description: Pile of various bent and twisted metals.

f_ash.name: pile of ash
f_ash.description: Some ash, from wood or possibly bodies.

f_boulder_small.name: small boulder
f_boulder_small.description: Blocking your path.  Should be easy to move.  It can be used as a primitive anvil.

f_boulder_small_harvested.name: upturned small boulder
f_boulder_small_harvested.description: Blocking your path.  Should be easy to move.  It can be used as a primitive anvil.

f_boulder_small_underwater.name: small boulder
f_boulder_small_underwater.description: Blocking your path.  Should be easy to move.  It can be used as a primitive anvil.

f_boulder_small_underwater_harvested.name: small boulder
f_boulder_small_underwater_harvested.description: Blocking your path.  Should be easy to move.  It can be used as a primitive anvil.

f_boulder_medium.name: medium boulder
f_boulder_medium.description: Blocking your path.  It'll be a struggle to move.  It can be used as a primitive anvil.

f_boulder_large.name: large boulder
f_boulder_large.description: Now how are you going to move this?

f_street_light.name: street light
f_street_light.description: Raised source of light which used to illuminate streets and their surrounding area, but it's useless without electricity.

f_traffic_light.name: traffic light
f_traffic_light.description: Signaling device positioned at road intersections and pedestrian crossings to control flows of traffic, but it's useless without electricity.

f_utility_pole.name: utility pole
f_utility_pole.description: A long wooden post which used to support overhead power lines and other public utilities, but it doesn't work anymore.

f_concrete_lump.name: concrete lump
f_concrete_lump.description: The result of you pouring concrete over mi-go gas emitters.  It's stuck to the floor.  It can be used as a primitive anvil.

f_flagpole_metal.name: flagpole
f_flagpole_metal.description: An old metal flagpole, with no flag to fly.  Don't lick it if it's cold out.

f_us_flag_metal.name: flagpole with American flag
f_us_flag_metal.description: An old metal flagpole flying an American flag.  A leftover from before the world ended, you could take it down if you need one for some reason.

f_flagpole_wood.name: wooden flagpole
f_flagpole_wood.description: A makeshift flagpole constructed from a wooden beam and rope.

f_us_flag_wood.name: wooden flagpole with American flag
f_us_flag_wood.description: Someone's hoisted an old American flag from this makeshift flagpole.

f_pirate_flag_metal.name: flagpole with Jolly Roger
f_pirate_flag_metal.description: An old metal flagpole, now flying a black pirate flag.

f_pirate_flag_wood.name: wooden flagpole with Jolly Roger
f_pirate_flag_wood.description: Someone's hoisted a black pirate flag from this makeshift flagpole.

f_room_divider.name: room divider
f_room_divider.description: A tall piece of furniture used to divide rooms into separate areas.

f_tarptent.name: tarp lean-to
f_tarptent.description: A small shelter covered by waterproof tarp, that can be used to take refuge from the elements.

f_tarptent_leather.name: leather tarp lean-to
f_tarptent_leather.description: A makeshift shelter made from a lather tarp and stakes driven into the ground.

f_console_broken_table.name: broken console
f_console_broken_table.description: This is a standalone computer terminal.  It doesn't seem to be working.  It's the broken screen and shattered circuit boards that's telling you that.

f_console_table.name: computer console
f_console_table.description: This is a standalone computer terminal.  It can be used to view contents and perform any allowed functions.  It might even be possible to hack it, given the skills.

f_artifact_analyzer_console.name: artifact analyzer console
f_artifact_analyzer_console.description: A research console configured to analyze artifacts.  Use it to scan any artifacts you are carrying.

f_forge.name: forge
f_forge.description: Metalworking station typically used in combination with an anvil.

f_still.name: still
f_still.description: An essential component for brewing and chemistry that allows for refining liquid mixtures.

f_kiln_empty.name: charcoal kiln
f_kiln_empty.description: A rock kiln designed to burn wood and organic material into charcoal in absence of oxygen.

f_kiln_full.name: filled charcoal kiln
f_kiln_full.description: A rock kiln designed to burn wood and organic material into charcoal in absence of oxygen.

f_kiln_metal_empty.name: metal charcoal kiln
f_kiln_metal_empty.description: A metal kiln designed to burn wood and organic material into charcoal in absence of oxygen.

f_kiln_metal_full.name: filled metal charcoal kiln
f_kiln_metal_full.description: A metal kiln designed to burn wood and organic material into charcoal in absence of oxygen.

f_arcfurnace_empty.name: arc furnace
f_arcfurnace_empty.description: An arc furnace designed to burn a powdery mix of coke and limestone to create calcium carbide.

f_arcfurnace_full.name: filled arc furnace
f_arcfurnace_full.description: An arc furnace designed to burn a powdery mix of coke and limestone to create calcium carbide.

f_smoking_rack.name: smoking rack
f_smoking_rack.description: A special rack designed to smoke food for better preservation and taste.  Works as a charcoal smoker in crafting recipes.

f_smoking_rack_active.name: active smoking rack
f_smoking_rack_active.description: A special rack designed to smoke food for better preservation and taste.  It is lit and smoking.

f_metal_smoking_rack.name: metal smoking rack
f_metal_smoking_rack.description: A special rack designed to smoke food for better preservation and taste.  Works as a charcoal smoker in crafting recipes.

f_metal_smoking_rack_active.name: active metal smoking rack
f_metal_smoking_rack_active.description: A special rack designed to smoke food for better preservation and taste.

f_forge_rock.name: rock forge
f_forge_rock.description: Metalworking station made of rock, typically used in combination with an anvil.  Works as a charcoal forge in crafting recipes.

f_clay_kiln.name: clay kiln
f_clay_kiln.description: A kiln designed to bake clay pottery and bricks.

f_char_purifier.name: charcoal purifier
f_char_purifier.description: A makeshift filter constructed to hold a supply of charcoal, for purifying water.

f_ladder.name: stepladder
f_ladder.description: A short, foldable ladder.  Can help you climb to a rooftop, or maybe slow something down.

f_arc_furnace.name: electric arc furnace
f_arc_furnace.description: Not the kind of furnace you'd heat your house with, this is a device for heating things to extreme temperatures as part of industrial fabrication processes.

f_drill_press.name: drill press
f_drill_press.description: A powerful drill mounted on a slide that lets it drop precisely down.  Useful in all kinds of projects from industrial fabrication to home woodworking.

f_tablesaw.name: tablesaw
f_tablesaw.description: A rotating saw blade set into a large flat table, for making straight measured cuts.  One of the key tools in a carpenter's arsenal.

f_mitresaw.name: mitre saw
f_mitresaw.description: A circular saw blade on an arm that can slide and rotate in several directions, this is a staple tool for nearly any carpentry.

f_bandsaw.name: bandsaw
f_bandsaw.description: A ribbonlike sawblade runs in a single direction in this tool, allowing precise cuts at almost any angle.

f_router.name: router table
f_router.description: This table has an inset router, a rotating motor with an exchangeable blade head for cutting specific profiles and grooves and stuff.

f_planer.name: planer
f_planer.description: A hefty tool that will take in a board and cut it smooth and flat to a specific width.  Particularly great if working with raw lumber stock, but also good just for shaving wood down to size.

f_jointer.name: jointer
f_jointer.description: A table-shaped tool with a rotating blade that will cut down, smooth out, and square off a board to make it very smooth and nice indeed.

f_heavy_lathe.name: power lathe
f_heavy_lathe.description: An industrial-grade lathe, for turning chunks of metal and other hard things into round chunks of metal and other hard things.  Power it back up and it could be used to practice Fabrication.

f_laser_cutter.name: industrial laser cutter
f_laser_cutter.description: A large box of tinted glass, with a robotic arm inside.  Before the cataclysm, it used to cut and etch sheet metal with a high-powered laser.  Now, it's better suited for scrap parts.

f_air_compressor.name: air compressor
f_air_compressor.description: This durable tank is topped with a motor that will cram as much air into the tank as possible.

f_fvat_empty.name: fermenting vat
f_fvat_empty.description: A sealable vat for fermenting vinegar and various alcoholic brews.

f_fvat_full.name: filled fermenting vat
f_fvat_full.description: A sealable vat for fermenting vinegar and various alcoholic brews.

f_butcher_rack.name: butchering rack
f_butcher_rack.description: Butchering rack designed to hang a carcass in the air.

f_metal_butcher_rack.name: metal butchering rack
f_metal_butcher_rack.description: Metal butchering rack designed to hang a carcass in the air.  It can be deconstructed and folded for easy transportation.

f_hanging_meathook.name: hanging meathook
f_hanging_meathook.description: A hefty hook suspended from a chain for stringing up corpses.

f_wind_mill.name: wind mill
f_wind_mill.description: A small wind-powered mill that can be used to grind down materials.

f_wind_mill_active.name: active wind mill
f_wind_mill_active.description: A small wind-powered mill that can be used to grind down materials.  Its brake has been removed and it is turning.

f_water_mill.name: water mill
f_water_mill.description: A small water-powered mill that can be used to grind down materials.

f_water_mill_active.name: active water mill
f_water_mill_active.description: A small water-powered mill that can be used to grind down materials.  Its brake has been removed and it is turning.

f_aut_gas_console_o.name: broken automated gas console
f_aut_gas_console_o.description: Automated gas flow control console.  Broken.  This is not a good thing.

f_vending_reinforced.name: reinforced vending machine
f_vending_reinforced.description: A bit tougher to crack open than regular vending machines.  That just makes it all the sweeter a target, doesn't it?

f_vending_c.name: vending machine
f_vending_c.description: Buy stuff with a cash card.

f_vending_o.name: broken vending machine
f_vending_o.description: Ponder if you could buy stuff, as it's broken.  Maybe if you broke it more, you wouldn't need to pay at all!

f_rope_up.name: rope leading up
f_rope_up.description: A rope.  You could climb it up.

f_rope_up_web.name: web rope leading up
f_rope_up_web.description: A web rope.  You could climb it up.

f_glowingbulb.name: luminous plant bulb
f_glowingbulb.description: A small plant grows among the roots here, its green onion-like bulb illuminating the area around it.

f_brambles.name: brambles
f_brambles.description: A wall of tangled roots blocks the path here, you'd have destroy it to get past.

f_midden.name: composting midden
f_midden.description: A hole that has been dug into the roots here, a pretty unpleasant smell emits from it.

f_autoclave_full.name: broken autoclave
f_autoclave_full.description: This thing is basically an extremely high tech laundry machine or dishwasher.  It seems to not do anything useful anymore.

f_floor_canvas.name: heavy punching bag
f_floor_canvas.description: Punch Punch!  Exercise those arms!  Main selling point: it doesn't fight back!  Examine it to practice your Unarmed skill.
